name: Kihatsu
source:
Kihatsu is a sweet, party-loving, hyper active and positive prince. He is always festive and tries to cheer everyone up with his positive glow. He is the most charismatic of the group and pulls everyone through the hard times with his positive attitude and smile. However, due to his straight forward nature and positive outlook, Taikoubou is always calling him an idiot prince.

Despite his happy go lucky nature, he is a very strong individual. Although he can't fight, he's still very strong mentally and physhically.

[from [url=http://azurebluephoenix.tumblr.com/post/72077349897/lgs-houshin-engi-the-dating-sim]Sapphire Dreams Tumblr[/url]]
